title: Will not fit in my washing machine
text:
Will not fit in my washing machine. I am downgrading my star rating on this item to reflect the fact that this does not fit in my washing machine. I have a fairly large front loader and this will not even allow me to close the door of the washer. In order to keep using this product, I will have to take this to a laundromat or have it dry cleaned...money and time I don't want to waste. If you have a super large washing machine, then this would be really nice.
_____________________________
I really like this mattress pad. I thought I would be getting a mattress pad like the one I already had on my bed. Oh my. Was I wrong. This mattress pad came in a huge box because it is very VERY plush. It is very thick which I like since it adds another comfort layer to my bed. It's also very soft. I have a fairly deep mattress and was worried this would not fit and stay put on my bed, but it does. I think this would stay put on a bed that was even deeper than my mattress.

I will be watching the seams of this mattress pad as the part that wraps around the mattress side is not very thick, and I wonder how strong the seams are. But so far so good.

The only negative I can see about this mattress pad for some people might be the fact that you will not be able to fit this into your washing machine. I have a front loader that is big enough to handle it, but not all washing machines would be big enough.

The insert that came with the mattress pad says the following..."Luxurious and soft, blended fabric to help regulate body temperature while allowing mattress to cool. Mattress pad is filled with hypoallergenic alternative down cluster fibers, and the specially made skirt is made to fit mattress' up to 18" deep".

description: High Quality Extra Plush Bamboo Fitted Mattress Pad/Topper

You'll enjoy the comfort of this luxurious mattress pad! Top-Quality, quilted bamboo blend fabric is silky to the touch and extra plush for a extra comfortable rest. This bamboo fabric breathes extra well and can even help cool down those extra warm mattress' such as Tempurpedic. Construction, top is 62% polyester/38% rayon from bamboo and is filled with plush cluster fiber. Cluster fiber is a innovative polyester material that is able to trap air to regulate temperature and allow the pad to maintain its shape longer all while providing additional plush support to your mattress. Backing is 100% polyester. Care Instructions: Machine wash cold in front load/high capacity washers only. Do not use machine with center agitator. Tumble dry low. Do not use softeners.
